[EN] Argon Indoctrination
[ES] Adoctrinamiento de argón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The {@creature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} have the samples we need.
[ES] Los {@creature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} tienen las muestras que necesitamos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'm sure the {@creature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} put up a struggle, but I'm glad you prevailed.
[ES] Estoy seguro de que los {@creature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} opusieron resistencia, pero me alegra que hayas triunfado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Get argon brainwashing samples from {@creature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} in {@Rgn:46004$$Raga Kabash}.
[ES] Consigue muestras de lavado de cerebro de argón de los {@creature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayers} en {@Rgn:46004$$Raga Kabash}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect argon brainwashing samples.
[ES] Recolecta muestras de lavado de cerebro de argón.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to the {@Rgn:46015$$Hexheart Chamber} and deliver the argon brainwashing samples to {@creature:246#1026$$Beranie}.
[ES] Regresa a la {@Rgn:46015$$Hexheart Chamber} y entrégale las muestras de lavado de cerebro de argón a {@creature:246#1026$$Beranie}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Argon Brainwashing Sample
[ES] Muestra de lavado de cerebro de argón
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the nearby elevator down and deliver the argon brainwashing samples to {@creature:246#1102$$Nevian} in the {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber}.
[ES] Toma el elevador cercano hacia abajo y entrégale las muestras de lavado de cerebro de argón a {@creature:246#1102$$Nevian} en la {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks for this."
[ES] "Gracias por esto".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
